labctl.notes: RETRONET BRIDGE (2026-08-22): n0 is a tap on vmbr-rn (NOT slirp); the guest is a DHCP client on the reserved 10.99.0.16/24 with NO default route (rn-tapnet.sh + the fail-closed guard chain BEOSRN-IN, which aborts the launch if it does not verify). PS/2 RELATIVE pointer (pointerRel) -- R5 has no absolute tablet, and it applies its own acceleration, so scripted pointer work must be closed-loop (slam to 0,0, step, screendump, correct). exec = telnet_unix_e: labctl exec beos over BeOS R5's OWN telnetd at 10.99.0.16:23 over the bridge (no hostfwd, no agent in the guest, no port forward), user baron, password from the station dir's telnet-exec.passwd which the launcher writes from registry/local.env; client /root/sunexec.py with SUN_RC=$? because R5's login shell is bash. R5's ftpd is on :21 the same way for file transfer. KDL/kernel debug still lands on serial.log. See docs/lab/retronet/STATION-beos.md.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# beos (VMID 143) - BeOS R5 Professional 5.0.3, the original behind haiku.
#   TCG (R5 #GPs under KVM: unhandled MSRs), pentium3, 1 CPU, 512 MB, IDE
#   qcow2 on an MBR partition, std VGA at the vesa-settings 1024x768x16, PS/2
#   relative pointer via the daemon's abs->rel path. RETRONET: rtl8139 on a tap
#   on vmbr-rn (DHCP-reserved 10.99.0.16, no default route, guard chain
#   BEOSRN-IN); ne2k_pci was the NIC until 2026-08-23 and had to go -- R5's
#   etherpci driver storms 'bad next packet' and dies under a real page load.
#   VERBATIM launcher with conditional -loadvm golden. Two fixes live INSIDE the
#   volume: config_manager/isa removed (PnP BIOS call page-faults input_server
#   under SeaBIOS) and multiprocessor_support disabled (PCI IRQs via the PIC).

museum.blurb: Be Inc.'s BeOS R5 (2000) — the multithreaded media OS behind Haiku's yellow tabs, running as it shipped.
museum.notes: Live streamhost tile. BeOS R5 Professional 5.0.3 installed from the archive.org Pro CD onto an MBR BFS partition; TCG-only (KVM #GP). Archetype: beige-tower-crt; a BeBox would be the ideal model but R5 x86 shipped on commodity PCs. On the retronet since 2026-08-23: rtl8139 on vmbr-rn, DHCP 10.99.0.16, browsing the museum corpus in NetPositive, and signed in to the museum's own ICQ gateway as UIN 50000 with ICBM .71 (the BeCQ successor, 2001) over the pre-OSCAR UDP-4000 door — the only station on the fleet that uses it; HiveBot greets a visitor about half a minute after the client signs on. See docs/lab/retronet/STATION-beos.md.
